title: ProviderRegistry
description: Schema for z-harness provider registry files (.z-harness/providers.json). Accepts version 1 (deprecated) and version 2.

version.description: Registry format version. 1 is deprecated (upgraded in-memory to v2); 2 is current.

schema_version.description: Optional schema version for runtime/contract convention. When present, must be 1.

roles.description: Named role assignments. Each key is a role name, each value is a provider key referencing an entry in 'providers'.

providers.description: Provider entries keyed by provider name.

aliases.description: Optional mapping of old provider names to new provider names for backward compatibility. Only meaningful in version 2.

ProviderEntry.description: Provider descriptor. v1 entries that omit 'kind' and 'args_template' are upgraded in-memory by the resolver before validation runs (kind defaults to 'cli', args_template to []). v2 authors must include them explicitly.

kind.description: Provider invocation kind: 'cli' for subprocess, 'sdk' for library/API call.

command.description: Executable name or entry point to invoke.

args_template.description: Argument list template passed to the command.

stdin.description: Whether the provider reads the prompt from stdin.

timeout_s.description: Maximum wall-clock seconds to wait for the provider to respond.

oneOf.description: Argument list template for injecting the model, e.g. ["--model", "{model}"]. The token {model} is replaced with the effective model at composition time.

model_arg_template.description: Optional model argument template. Null or absent means model stays embedded in args_template (legacy mode).

oneOf.description: Environment variable name to set to the effective model value at subprocess time.

model_env_var.description: Optional environment variable for passing the model. Null or absent means no model env var is set.

oneOf.description: Default model identifier for this provider, e.g. "gpt-5-codex".

default_model.description: Optional default model. Used when the resolved effective model is empty. Null means no provider-level default.

auth_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the API key for SDK-tier auth (e.g. 'ANTHROPIC_API_KEY'). Optional; only relevant for kind='sdk'.

session_resumable.description: Whether this provider supports resuming a prior conversation session. Defaults to false.

allow_cross_vendor_env.description: If true, the driver may pass cross-vendor API key env vars (e.g. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY into a codex subprocess) instead of stripping them. Defaults to false (strip). Codex driver opt-in escape hatch; see C2 SPEC Invariant #4.
